note: A simplified way-finding graph over the museum's real floor layout (ground/first/second). Used to answer 'how do I get to X from here' questions, anchored on the visitor's last-tapped artifact's gallery.

edges.forward: From the main entrance, walk straight ahead through the Rotunda. The Harappan Civilization gallery is the first hall on your left.
edges.backward: Leave the Harappan gallery the way you came in and cross the Rotunda; the main entrance is straight ahead.

edges.forward: The cloakroom is just to the right of the main entrance, before the ticket check.
edges.backward: From the cloakroom, the main entrance is a few steps to your left.

edges.forward: The museum shop is on the ground floor, just past the entrance on the right.
edges.backward: From the museum shop, head back towards the Rotunda; the main entrance is just ahead.

edges.forward: The café is on the ground floor, near the garden side past the entrance lobby.
edges.backward: From the café, walk back through the entrance lobby to reach the main entrance.

edges.forward: Ground floor washrooms are just off the entrance lobby, past the cloakroom.
edges.backward: From the washrooms, the entrance lobby and main entrance are back the way you came.

edges.forward: The lift is in the central Rotunda, opposite the main entrance.
edges.backward: From the lift, the main entrance is straight ahead across the Rotunda.

edges.forward: The exit gate is beside the main entrance, on the visitor's left as you face outward.
edges.backward: The main entrance is right beside the exit gate.

edges.forward: The auditorium is on the ground floor, down the corridor to the left of the entrance lobby.
edges.backward: From the auditorium, follow the corridor back to the entrance lobby.

edges.forward: Continue through the far door of the Harappan gallery into the Bronze Gallery.
edges.backward: Go back through the connecting door into the Harappan Civilization gallery.

edges.forward: Walk through to the adjoining Sculpture Gallery.
edges.backward: Walk back through to the Bronze Gallery.

edges.forward: Head back towards the Rotunda; the lift and staircase are on your right.
edges.backward: From the lift, the Sculpture Gallery is just off the Rotunda.

edges.forward: Take the lift or stairs to the First floor. The Miniature Paintings gallery is directly ahead as you exit.
edges.backward: From Miniature Paintings, return to the lift landing to go back down.

edges.forward: The Manuscripts gallery is the next hall along the First floor corridor.
edges.backward: Continue along the First floor corridor back to Miniature Paintings.

edges.forward: Continue along the corridor into the Central Asian Antiquities gallery.
edges.backward: Head back along the corridor to the Manuscripts gallery.

edges.forward: The Jewellery Gallery is at the end of the First floor corridor.
edges.backward: From the Jewellery Gallery, walk back along the corridor to Central Asian Antiquities.

edges.forward: First floor washrooms are near the lift landing, just before Miniature Paintings.
edges.backward: From the washrooms, Miniature Paintings is just ahead.

edges.forward: Take the lift or stairs to the Second floor. Arms & Armour is directly ahead as you exit.
edges.backward: From Arms & Armour, return to the lift landing to go back down.

edges.forward: The Coins gallery (Numismatics & Epigraphy) is next along the Second floor corridor.
edges.backward: Head back along the corridor to Arms & Armour.

edges.forward: Continue into the Decorative Arts gallery.
edges.backward: Walk back to the Coins gallery.

edges.forward: The Wood Carving & Musical Instruments gallery is at the end of the Second floor corridor.
edges.backward: From Wood Carving & Musical Instruments, walk back to the Decorative Arts gallery.

edges.forward: Second floor washrooms are near the lift landing, just before Arms & Armour.
edges.backward: From the washrooms, Arms & Armour is just ahead.
